text:
I still remember the challenge we faced when building ML pipelines for a biotech client - managing features across different models was a nightmare. 
We had to ensure that features were consistently defined, computed, and shared across the organization. 
That's when we decided to leverage Databricks Feature Store to streamline our ML workflows.

By using the `feature_store` API in PySpark, we were able to create a centralized repository of features, making it easy to manage and share them across different models. 
We also utilized `Delta Lake` to store features, ensuring data quality and reliability. 
The approach involved creating a `FeatureStore` client, defining features using `Feature` objects, and then computing and writing features to the store using `compute` and `write` methods.

The result was astounding - we reduced the ETL runtime by 40% on 500M+ daily records, making our ML pipelines more efficient and scalable. 
This experience taught me the importance of leveraging the right tools and technologies to solve complex problems in data engineering. 
I'm excited to apply this knowledge in my next role, driving innovation in the healthcare and biotech industries.
